facts.fact: 九月的田纳西依旧闷热，她和 Daniel 一起去酒吧 Rooster’s，而他是个死神，对这股热毫无反应。
facts.anchor: Instead, I’m walking to a bar with a Grim Reaper who doesn’t seem to notice the heat.

facts.fact: Daniel 对 Rooster’s 这个地方满腹怀疑，他穿着一身西装，在酒吧里格格不入。
facts.anchor: “This is where you wanted to come?” Daniel looks skeptical.

facts.fact: 他迟疑片刻后主动牵起她的手、拽着她穿过人群；她下意识回握，接触时有如触电。
facts.anchor: With only a moment’s hesitation he takes my hand and tugs me forward through the crowd.

facts.fact: 死灵仍能品尝味道，咖啡是他从二十世纪二十年代才喜欢上的；她因此知道他远不止一百岁。
facts.anchor: “I can still taste,” he says. “It’s one of the few pleasures we still have. Coffee, as you’ve noted, is a favorite. Though I didn’t grow fond of that until the 1920s.”

facts.fact: 他无法离职：为了不去地狱，他签下了永世做收魂人的契约。
facts.anchor: “No. I cannot quit. This isn’t a job the way you think of jobs. Becoming a Reaper for eternity was the deal I struck to avoid being sent to Hell.”

facts.fact: 他不喜欢被人触碰——她握住他的手时会忘掉这一点。
facts.anchor: I keep forgetting that he doesn’t like touching me.

facts.fact: 酒后的她终于承认自己害怕的是死亡与死后。
facts.anchor: “I’m scared,” I finally admit on a whisper.

facts.fact: 临别时他叫了她的名字 Lucy，此前一直以 Ms. McKenzie 相称。
facts.anchor: “Good night, Lucy,” he repeats, his voice sounding oddly strained.
